instagram.caption:
ADHD mom nap time: what I planned vs what actually happened ⏳

Nap time is my one quiet hour. The plan was 3 tiny tasks:

1. Sign the school trip form
2. Pay the electric bill
3. Book the pediatrician

20 minutes in, I'd reorganized the snack drawer. I'm not lazy. I just can't start.

So I said it out loud to FOCO. Step 1 was "open the school email". 1 minute. All 3 were done at 2:55. She woke up at 3:02.

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting.

📌 Save this for the next nap, and send it to a mom friend who gets it.
💜 The app is FOCO, link in bio.
